newsitem.title: FRANCE: Skis Rossignol sees full-year profit dip.
newsitem.headline: Skis Rossignol sees full-year profit dip.

text.p: France's Skis Rossignol said on Monday it expected a fall in full-year profit.

It made the forecast in a statement which showed a slip in net consolidated profit in the six months to September 30 to 129.03 million francs ($24.6 million) from 148.47 in the same period last year and turnover down to 1.210 billion from 1.140 billion.

"For the 1996/97 financial year, as a result of the charges incurred on the one hand by development priorities and on the other the clear increase in amortisation costs, the group result will slip, like in the first half, compared to the preceding year," the statement said. gd/bfl ($ = 5.239 French Francs)
